trigger_steps: App was already launched and main feed was visible with Home selected.
Tapped the bottom Search tab at nav_tab_search.
Stopped on the Search tab without tapping search_card or entering SearchActivity.
Final layout confirmed nav_tab_search is selected and search_card is visible.

evidence.note: The Search tab is selected, so the checkpoint is valid for evaluating the Search tab UI.

search_card is visible, but its child search_text_view text is "Track what you've been reading here." and search_icon content-desc is also "Track what you've been reading here." This describes reading history, not searching Wikipedia or asking/searching anything.

The spec explicitly forbids the Search card copy from describing reading history or recently viewed articles. Because the Search tab and search_card are visible, this is a fail rather than inconclusive.
